recipes.name: Traditional Tomato Gazpacho
instructions: Add the tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, bread, onion, and garlic to a blender. Blend into a chunky sauce*.
Then add the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth.
Pass the soup through a sieve to remove any remaining chunks.
Chill the gazpacho in the fridge for at least 2 hours before serving. Garnish as desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Use ripe, in-season tomatoes for the best flavour. Tomato size can vary, but for us, 6 medium tomatoes weighed about 800g. † For us, ½ cucumber weighed 185g. † For us, 1 large slice of bread weighed 55g. * Don't blend for too long, as the colour will get less vibrant.
Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
